answer.basis: Do not use the claimed €312,000 profit; use corrected, independently supported accounts for any earn-out.

aiProposal.basis: Do not use the claimed €312,000 profit; use corrected, independently supported accounts for any earn-out.

decisions.independentChallenge: Agent 2 proposal: Do not use management's €312,000 profit for an earn-out. Use the corrected €65,000 base case, with a disclosed €60,000-€79,000 sensitivity and contractual protection for unresolved items. Challenge: The takeover deck's €312,000 might be contractually convenient for the earn-out.
decisions.studentReasoning: Student-certified reasoning: Management profit of €312,000 includes September revenue, a bank loan recorded as income, incomplete costs, and omitted adjustments.
